notes: Scan DigitalOcean project ttw-tmpval for resources older than max_lifetime_hours.
Flag Droplets, Managed Postgres, Spaces buckets, reserved IPs, and firewalls lacking a matching OpenTofu state entry.
Orphan scan is owner-gated (requires DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN); credential-free CI only validates this policy file exists and max_lifetime_hours is set.
Never leave temporary-validation resources running overnight without an explicit owner waiver recorded in the release evidence.
